title: Spell
description: A spell: a composition of one or more effects (drawn from the shared effect registry) tagged with a color magic school. The governing skill is <color>_magic.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

level.description: The spell's place on the level scale; a dispel of magnitude N ends standing spells of level N or below (docs/core/casting.md).

delivery.description: How an offensive spell reaches its target, which decides the defense (docs/core/casting.md#delivery-and-saves).

save.description: What an instant spell's target rolls: an attribute or a skill.

concentration.description: True if the caster holds the spell; a caster holds one, and a new one ends the old (docs/core/casting.md).

effects.description: The applied effects. At least one, unless the spell has a summon block.

summon.description: What a summon spell calls, in place of a core:effect/summon entry (docs/core/casting.md#summons).

cost.description: Casting cost: any reagents. The mana is never stored: every reader computes it from the effects by the spellcraft cost formula (docs/modules/magic.md#cost-formula, DE_S02_05), so a row or override that writes mana fails. Magic is paid in mana at a table and in real time alike; no spell costs stamina (docs/core/actions.md#one-rule-set-two-clocks).

reagents.description: Ingredient refs (namespaced core:ingredient/<key>) used as reagents for this spell

template.description: True for a plain learnable spell, one per target shape, whose mana cost and cast threshold are exactly the cost formula's (docs/modules/magic.md#template-spells).

custom.description: True for player-made (spellmaking) spells; false or omitted for authored content

summon.description: A summon block. The base part, group and duration, is all a single summon needs; the minion part, minion and count, is only for minion spells (docs/core/casting.md#minions).

minion.description: True for a minion spell: the creatures are minions, outside the summon limit and its bonuses.

count.description: How many minions: a number, or dice rolled when the spell is cast (the caller passes count_roll).

spellWithBase.description: A spell written as another spell plus what differs (docs/core/composition.md#a-spell-built-on-a-spell). It is resolved to a flat spell before validation, so this is the shape a file holds, not the one a reader sees.

base.description: The spell this one builds on; it may not itself name a base.

overrides.description: The fields that differ from the base spell; an object field merges per field.

summon.description: Merged per field into the base's summon block.
